vnpy.trader.gateway module¶

class vnpy.trader.gateway.BaseGateway(event_engine: EventEngine, gateway_name: str)¶

基类：ABC

Abstract gateway class for creating gateways connection to different trading systems.

# How to implement a gateway:

--- ## Basics A gateway should satisfies: * this class should be thread-safe:

  • all methods should be thread-safe

  • no mutable shared properties between objects.

  • all methods should be non-blocked

  • satisfies all requirements written in docstring for every method and callbacks.

  • automatically reconnect if connection lost.

--- ## methods must implements: all @abstractmethod

--- ## callbacks must response manually: * on_tick * on_trade * on_order * on_position * on_account * on_contract

All the XxxData passed to callback should be constant, which means that

the object should not be modified after passing to on_xxxx.

So if you use a cache to store reference of data, use copy.copy to create a new object before passing that data into on_xxxx

abstractmethod cancel_order(req: CancelRequest) → None¶

Cancel an existing order. implementation should finish the tasks blow: * send request to server

cancel_quote(req: CancelRequest) → None¶

Cancel an existing quote. implementation should finish the tasks blow: * send request to server

abstractmethod close() → None¶

Close gateway connection.

abstractmethod connect(setting: dict) → None¶

Start gateway connection.

to implement this method, you must: * connect to server if necessary * log connected if all necessary connection is established * do the following query and response corresponding on_xxxx and write_log

  • contracts : on_contract

  • account asset : on_account

  • account holding: on_position

  • orders of account: on_order

  • trades of account: on_trade

  • if any of query above is failed, write log.

future plan: response callback/change status instead of write_log

default_name: str = ''¶
default_setting: dict[str, str | int | float | bool] = {}¶
exchanges: list[Exchange] = []¶
get_default_setting() → dict[str, str | int | float | bool]¶

Return default setting dict.

on_account(account: AccountData) → None¶

Account event push. Account event of a specific vt_accountid is also pushed.

on_contract(contract: ContractData) → None¶

Contract event push.

on_event(type: str, data: object = None) → None¶

General event push.

on_log(log: LogData) → None¶

Log event push.

on_order(order: OrderData) → None¶

Order event push. Order event of a specific vt_orderid is also pushed.

on_position(position: PositionData) → None¶

Position event push. Position event of a specific vt_symbol is also pushed.

on_quote(quote: QuoteData) → None¶

Quote event push. Quote event of a specific vt_symbol is also pushed.

on_tick(tick: TickData) → None¶

Tick event push. Tick event of a specific vt_symbol is also pushed.

on_trade(trade: TradeData) → None¶

abstractmethod send_order(req: OrderRequest) → str¶

Send a new order to server.

implementation should finish the tasks blow: * create an OrderData from req using OrderRequest.create_order_data * assign a unique(gateway instance scope) id to OrderData.orderid * send request to server

  • if request is sent, OrderData.status should be set to Status.SUBMITTING

  • if request is failed to sent, OrderData.status should be set to Status.REJECTED

  • response on_order:

  • return vt_orderid

:return str vt_orderid for created OrderData

send_quote(req: QuoteRequest) → str¶

Send a new two-sided quote to server.

implementation should finish the tasks blow: * create an QuoteData from req using QuoteRequest.create_quote_data * assign a unique(gateway instance scope) id to QuoteData.quoteid * send request to server

  • if request is sent, QuoteData.status should be set to Status.SUBMITTING

  • if request is failed to sent, QuoteData.status should be set to Status.REJECTED

  • response on_quote:

  • return vt_quoteid

:return str vt_quoteid for created QuoteData

abstractmethod subscribe(req: SubscribeRequest) → None¶

Subscribe tick data update.

write_log(msg: str) → None¶

Write a log event from gateway.
